ops.title: cc-sudo quarantine-on-update fixed via homebrew-tap PR #3
ops.body: release-swift.yml rendered a plain binary cask with no de-quarantine postflight, so com.apple.quarantine persisted on every Homebrew update and broke non-interactive cc-sudo exec. Fixed in homebrew-tap PR #3 (frozen head 6147a0a, CI green): a signature-verified de-quarantine postflight (codesign --verify --strict against the Developer ID requirement for team SXKCTF23Q2 + identifier cc-sudo, raise on failure, then xattr -d the single staged file — never -dr, only when the attribute is present), a generator gate ported from release-go PR #2, and test.yml contract coverage. Astra review: SAFE; non-blocking follow-ups = pin the Developer ID leaf/CA OIDs tap-wide and convert the macos-floor to the symbol form. The gate's team grep requires the requirement be a Ruby single-quoted string so literal double-quotes survive rendering. cc-sudo pin candidate branch bump-release-swift-pin-dequarantine (d7dc7b5, NO PR) repins release.yml 41f8de6 -> 6147a0a; do not merge/tag until the tap PR merges, then repin to the merge SHA. Report: ~/.claude/runs/ccx-fs-churn-20261001/cc-sudo-swift-quarantine-report.md
